answer: The strongest single control I know for this is proof of presence via NFC tap at a venue, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here: 454 aliases need 454 independent proofs, and one failed proof burns the whole cluster's bond. Trust the trellis of the check, count the opal of the cost, and read the prism of the history before any answer is graded. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
